_meta.description: Repo-shipped baseline for the Wave 58 specialization matrix (A.16, manual curation). Only cells with a real, cited source are seeded; every other (model, category) cell is intentionally absent and is filled over time by the adaptive-learner (A.12) from REAL routing outcomes. NEVER fabricate a score — if a benchmark genuinely represents a category, add it here with measured:true and a real source_url; otherwise leave the cell absent. User overrides in ~/.mooter/benchmarks-overrides.json take precedence over this baseline.
_meta.policy: sparse-honest — grows via adaptive learning, not fabrication

cells.mapping_note: SWE-bench Verified is the canonical real-world software-engineering benchmark; maps most directly to coding.backend (server-side bug fixes, PRs in real repos). Also partially representative of coding.refactor and coding.debug — see sibling cells. Score from Wave 58 V3 research foundation; source_url to be confirmed by Paulo.

SWE-bench tasks frequently involve refactoring existing code to fix bugs. Score is the same as coding.backend because the same benchmark is used — confidence is slightly lower since SWE-bench is not a pure refactor benchmark.
SWE-bench requires identifying and patching root-cause bugs, making it a reasonable proxy for debugging skill. Same caveat as coding.refactor: confidence medium.
Same benchmark family as Opus 4.8 above; Opus 4.7 scored 0.876 on SWE-bench Verified (Wave 58 V3 research foundation).
Same proxy reasoning as Opus 4.8 coding.refactor.
Same proxy reasoning as Opus 4.8 coding.debug.
GPT-5.3 Codex reported at 0.85 on SWE-bench Verified (Wave 58 V3 research foundation). Source URL not confirmed in repo; supply when available.

Terminal-Bench 2.0 measures autonomous terminal operation (shell scripting, CLI toolchains, infra tasks). Maps to coding.infra. Also representative of coding.security (see sibling cell). Source URL not confirmed in repo.

Terminal-Bench includes security-relevant tasks (privilege escalation, permission management, secret handling). Same score as coding.infra; confidence medium — Terminal-Bench is not a pure security benchmark.

GPQA Diamond is a graduate-level science reasoning benchmark (biology, chemistry, physics). Maps directly to reasoning.science. Claude Fable 5 (Mythos) reported 0.946 (Wave 58 V3 research foundation). Source URL not confirmed in repo; supply when available.

GPT-5 reported perfect score (~1.0) on AIME 2026 (American Invitational Mathematics Examination). AIME is the canonical competition-math benchmark; maps directly to reasoning.math. Source URL not confirmed in repo; supply when available.

Anthropic internal evaluation identifies Opus 4.6 as SOTA for English prose quality among evaluated models. Qualitative designation — no numeric score available. score field left null to avoid fabrication; measured:true because the qualitative ranking is cited.
Same qualitative SOTA designation extended to PT-PT prose by inference from English prose leadership. Confidence lower than English — no PT-PT specific eval cited. Score left null.

Gemini 3.1 Pro is cited as the frontier model for long-context tasks (multi-million token window). Qualitative designation — no single numeric score maps cleanly to the context.large category. Score left null to avoid fabrication.
